PARALLEL / QUICK GUIDE

See the difference.
Keep every version in view.

01

Add your versions

Start with two empty panels. Add panel opens more, up to eight. Remove a panel with × and the others fill the space. Paste a website URL, drop an image or choose a standalone HTML file. Uploaded files stay in your browser.

02

Match viewport widths

Choose 1440, 768 or 390 px, or enter a custom width. Fit scales each preview to its panel while keeping the selected viewport width. Images keep their original layout.

03

Scroll together

Images and uploaded HTML can share a scroll position by percentage of page height. External websites scroll independently because browsers restrict access to their content.

04

When a site stays blank

Some websites block embedding. Use ↗ to open the site in a new tab, or upload a screenshot. HTTPS pages may also block websites that use HTTP.

For HTML, use one file with embedded CSS, images and fonts. Scripts and external requests in uploaded HTML are disabled.
